title: Popular military air show permanently pulled from RAF Fairford after suspected terror threat
description: Over a month after a suspected Iranian plot on RAF Fairford, organizers of the world's largest military air show announced its permanent departure to MOD Boscombe Down.

title: Pentagon barred Qatar base access to hide Iran war damage, US senator claims
description: Sen. Chris Murphy, D-Conn., was denied access to Al Udeid Air Base, Qatar, during a recent Congressional Delegation trip in what he calls a "cover-up."

title: France vows tough response to freezer cyberattack blamed on Iran
description: France's Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot said Tuesday, November 10, that Paris ruled out "nothing" to respond to a major cyberattack on hundreds of supermarket fridges in October that it has blamed on Iran. The goal, Jean-Noel Barrot told France Info, is "to deter anyone who might be tempted, in Iran or elsewhere, to do it again".

title: US Republican Thomas Massie launches bid to impeach Pete Hegseth
description: US Republican Thomas Massie moved Monday, November 9, to force a vote to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, pressing his fellow Republicans to remove one of the Trump administration's most prominent figures following sweeping election losses blamed in part on fallout from the war in Iran. FRANCE 24's correspondent in Washington Fraser Jackson has more.

title: Russia and Ukraine hold US-backed talks after Trump says broad deal is possible
description: Russian and Ukrainian officials met on Tuesday, November 10, for their first US-brokered talks since February, after US President Donald Trump suggested last week that a broad deal was possible on ending the war in Ukraine and guaranteeing security in Europe. FRANCE 24's correspondent in Kyiv Emmanuelle Chaze and FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Rochelle Ferguson have more.

title: China's 'impossible to ignore' tech rise on display at Web Summit in Lisbon
description: One of Europe's biggest annual tech events, the Web Summit, kicked off in the Portuguese capital this week with the biggest ever delegation of Chinese business leaders and policymakers. FRANCE 24's Charles Pellegrin talks to Dr. Dan Wang, China Director at Eurasia Group, about EU-China tech relations, the climate of suspicion created by the spying scandal at Nvidia, and what the EU's quest for tech sovereignty could mean for China.

title: New Israel parliament to be sworn in as Eisenkot works to form new govt
description: Israel's new parliament will be sworn on Tuesday, November 10, with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu set to lose his majority as rival Gadi Eisenkot works to form a new government. The opposition hopes to use its newfound legislative power to move quickly on key priorities, including a commission to investigate security failures under Netanyahu that allowed the October 7, 2023 attack by Hamas. FRANCE 24's correspondent in Jerusalem Noga Tarnopol

title: US Hegseth faces Republican impeachment bid over abuse of power in Iran war
description: A Republican lawmaker moved on Monday to impeach US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth over the war in Iran, setting the stage for a potentially explosive vote in Congress, days after President Donald Trump's party suffered a crushing defeat in the midterms. Kentucky Congressman Thomas Massie introduced eight articles of impeachment, accusing Hegseth of waging war illegally without congressional authorisation and abusing his powers as Pentagon chief.

title: China's charm offensive pays off as foreign tourism rebounds
description: How is tourism faring in China seven years after the Covid-19 pandemic? The country reopened its borders in 2023 and is playing the charm card to restore its image. A strategy that’s paying off: last year the number of tourists exceeded pre-pandemic levels, and French travelers are among those flocking there.

title: Ukraine peace talks: Who is sitting at the negotiating table – and why it matters
description: Three-way talks between Russia, Ukraine and the United States opened Tuesday in the United Arab Emirates, as Washington made a renewed push to end the war that followed Moscow's invasion of its neighbour nearly five years ago. title: Nvidia spy scandal fuels debate over chip exports to China
description: US lawmakers call for tighter restrictions on chip sales amid inquiry into Nvidia CEOs relationship with alleged spy.

title: UFC CEO Dana White takes the White House podium during Washington visit
description: During his visit to meet with US President Donald Trump in Washington, Dana White answers questions at the White House.

title: Pakistan TV anchor allegedly shot dead at home by her husband
description: Pakistan TV anchor Rabiya Ahsan was shot dead at home. Police are probing her husbands claim of accidental firing.

title: Trump says Israel, Gulf allies must repay Iran war cost: What does it mean?
description: Analysts say Trump’s comments are more likely to be political posturing than a reflection of serious policy priorities.

title: Who moves first in Iran-US diplomacy?
description: Breaking the deadlock requires coordinated, verifiable concessions, not demands for one side to act first.

title: Moroccan trio make African Player of Year shortlist as Salah absent
description: WAFCON winners Cameroon dominate women’s list after heroics from Monique Ngock, Michaely Bihina and Marie Ngah Manga.

title: France summons Iran’s ambassador over supermarket fridge ‘sabotage’
description: The French government said it is seeking tough sanctions to deter further cyberattacks across Europe.
